A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CASteer and contain readable main text and Appendices A–O. Text, equations, tables, and figures can be reliably matched despite reflow and renumbering.

before.justification: v4 reports original CASteer experiments on concept erasure and image preservation, together with user studies, ablations, and supplementary evaluations.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental results, including the evaluations in Section 4, user studies in Appendix D, and ablations in Appendix H.

M1.justification: Steering-vector construction, cross-attention intervention, clipping, distilled-model transfer, weight integration, and the appendix extensions remain unchanged. The correction to Equation 22 expresses the averaging procedure already described in v4.

E1.justification: The datasets, concepts, and tasks remain unchanged, including I2P, COCO-30k, object and artist-style erasure, implicit prompts, and supplementary editing scenarios. The Iron Man actor example already appears in v4 Appendix K; its corrected caption does not introduce new coverage.

E2.justification: The comparator sets are retained. Figure 4 is unchanged, and v5 Table 5 repeats comparisons already reported in v4 Table 36, including ESD, SPM, SAFREE, both Receler settings, and DoCo. DoCo also already participates in the case studies whose captions are corrected.

E3.justification: Section 4 changes the reported abstract-concept prompt count from 196 to 210, matching Appendix C.2, which already specified 210. The layer-ablation baseline label changes from SDXL to SD-1.4 in v4 Table 24/v5 Table 25. These are reported-setting corrections; the PDFs do not establish reruns.

E4.justification: The prompt-count, weighting, strength, and layer ablations, steering-vector visualizations, adversarial cases, and transfer analyses are retained. Removing v4 Figure 50 removes a duplicate of Figure 49, rather than distinct analytical evidence.

E5.justification: The three-run artist-recognition evaluation in Appendix E and three prompt-set/seed realizations in Appendix H.1 are unchanged. Shared-seed specifications and statistical reporting practices are also retained.

E6.justification: Numerical scores, rankings, and distinct qualitative outcomes are retained. Every result row in the added Table 5 already appears in v4 Table 36, retained as v5 Table 37; for example, CASteer's Snoopy CLIP scores remain 45.8 without clipping and 48.5 with clipping.

T1.justification: Appendix M, Equation 22 corrects a malformed fraction with the concept vector in the denominator to the arithmetic mean, (1/n) times the sum of concept vectors. This is a limited correction to the displayed mathematical definition; Appendix L's assumptions, theorem, corollary, and proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free, precise concept erasure, multiple-concept handling, transfer across diffusion backbones, and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the erasure–preservation tradeoff and steering mechanisms are retained. Appendix A preserves the same limitations concerning cross-attention architectures, curated prompt pairs, potential bias, and incomplete mechanistic understanding.

D1.justification: Appendix A replaces its statement about a minimal supplementary code ZIP with repository access instructions; both abstracts already linked that repository. The prompt-count documentation is corrected, while hardware, timings, and detailed generation settings remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to prior erasure and latent-steering methods are unchanged. Changes to the NudeNet, Rao, and SmithMano references complete bibliographic information rather than introduce new works.

P1.justification: v5 makes local spelling, punctuation, terminology, and cross-reference corrections, adds acknowledgments, and changes the preprint headers to ICLR 2026 publication headers. The narrative and substantive section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: v5 adds Table 5 as a separate display of existing results, removes the duplicated Figure 50, and renumbers the former Figure 51 as Figure 50 with the correct Iron Man actor caption. Other changes include caption corrections and limited page reflow.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves consistency and readability by reconciling the prompt count, correcting Equation 22 and misleading case-study captions, repairing cross-references, and removing a duplicate panel. Table 5 makes existing comparisons easier to locate. These are useful reporting improvements, while the empirical evidence and scientific contribution remain essentially unchanged.
